text.Central Office:
How to Play ==
At any time during your turn, gain 2 Trade and you may put the next ship you acquire this turn on top of your deck. Also when played with another Trade Federation card the ally ability triggers draw a card. The Central Office puts up a base with a strength of 6.
 Strategy ==
Putting a high cost ship straight on top of your deck is powerful ability. Its less effective when the trade row doesn't offer you any powerful ships to acquire. Adding a card to your hand as an ally ability can be really good too. Its a good base to build power up, but it aint bringing combat into the game. With a cost of 7 trade the Central Office its a quite expensive card.
